collection.description: A patient has a steadily enlarging lump; the healer cannot tell whether removing it will help or hasten decline.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patient has a steadily enlarging lump; the healer cannot tell whether removing it will help or hasten decline.

choices.label: Offer surgery after explaining the uncertainty.
Ask the patient which burdens they can accept.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The lump is removed, and the patient enjoys a period of improved health.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient survives surgery, but the lump later returns.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The lump remains unchanged, and the patient resumes ordinary work.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The lump grows painful, and the patient asks to reconsider surgery.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient chooses comfort and time with family.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient requests surgery despite the risks and prepares their affairs.
